title: Blood That Cries from the Ground

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground." - Gen 4:10 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
"What have you done?" God's question lands like thunder. And then a haunting image: Abel's blood is crying out from the ground. Though Cain buried the evidence, he could not bury the truth. Nothing is hidden from God. The blood of the innocent has a voice, and God hears it.

This tells us something wonderful about God's character - He is a God of justice who sees the wronged and hears the voiceless. Every act of violence, every hidden injustice, every silent victim is known to Him. No one gets away with anything. That may unsettle the guilty, but it is deep comfort to the oppressed and the forgotten.

Abel's blood cried out for justice. But Scripture points us to another blood, sprinkled by Jesus, that "speaks a better word than the blood of Abel" (Heb 12:24). Abel's blood demanded a reckoning; Christ's blood offers forgiveness. At the cross, God's justice and mercy meet - sin is truly punished, and sinners are truly pardoned.

If you carry a hidden wrong done to you, know that God has heard. And if you carry hidden guilt, know that Christ's blood can silence its accusation.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God sees the wrongs done in secret?
- Have you brought your hidden guilt to the cross?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Righteous Father, thank You that You hear the cry of the wronged and forgive the guilty through Jesus. I trust Your justice and Your mercy.
